fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 93% match is a STRONG FIT for this Senior/Software Engineer II, Backend role.

**Strengths:**
- Ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot
- Built Java services on PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ at Northgate
- On call for payments, wrote 14 post-incident reviews
- Datadog and AWS (EC2, RDS, SQS, S3) cover the cloud and observability preferences

**Gaps:**
- No OpenTelemetry, Grafana or Prometheus listed; Datadog partly covers this
- No ad serving or mediation experience for the Ads team
- Feb 2023 to now shows no listed role

**Recommendation:** Apply now, and open your cover letter with the settlement service and incident ownership, then link your payments traffic experience to ad serving.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 13, 2026

Hiring Manager
Duolingo

Dear Hiring Manager,

You're looking for backend engineers who can build and operate reliable, scalable systems and own hard problems from design through production. At Lumen Payments, a fintech with 300 staff, I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, and I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services.

That work is the same kind of problem your Ads team faces when growing and scaling ad serving. I cut p99 latency on our payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis, and I kept the platform healthy as the on-call engineer, writing the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents. I've built event-driven services on Kafka and run them on AWS, and I've used Datadog for monitoring. I work in Kotlin, Java and Python, with a B.Sc. in Computer Science from the University of Waterloo. After a planned career break, I earned my AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification in 2024 and am returning to full-time engineering.

I'd like to talk about how my experience with scalable backend services and cross-functional product work could help Duolingo's Monetization team. I'm available to start a conversation at your convenience.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.body:
Hello Duolingo Backend Hiring Team,

You're hiring a backend engineer who can develop, release and maintain services and keep shipping, and at Lumen Payments I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, then led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. I bring 11 years of backend experience in Java, Kotlin and Python, with PostgreSQL and Redis behind the services I've built. My CV and cover letter are attached for more detail. I'm available for a call any weekday and can start a conversation about the role whenever suits your team.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
